NIA Seizes Srinagar Property Used to Harbor Pakistani Terrorists

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has seized a property in Srinagar that was allegedly used to provide shelter to Pakistani terrorists. The property belongs to Ghulam Mohammad Mir, also known as 'Mama Gus'. Investigations suggest links to entities across the border.
